typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	effDate as string (),
	emptyFile as string (),
	fileName as string (),
	grgrId as string (),
	logPath as string (),
	runId as integer (),
	triggerDir as string ()
}

source(output(
		RUNID_834 as integer,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		SGSG_ID as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		MEME_MEDCD_NO as string,
		MEME_HICN as string,
		MEME_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEME_MID_INIT as string,
		MEME_SEX as string,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT as string,
		MEME_MCTR_LANG as string,
		MEPE_EFF_DT as string,
		MEPE_TERM_DT as string,
		SBAD_ADDR1 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR2 as string,
		SBAD_CITY as string,
		SBAD_STATE as string,
		SBAD_ZIP as string,
		SBSB_MCTR_VIP as string,
		SGSG_NAME as string,
		SBAD_PHONE as string,
		PRPR_NPI as string,
		PRAD_CITY as string,
		PRAD_STATE as string,
		PRAD_ZIP as string,
		PRAD_PHONE as string,
		PRAD_FAX as string,
		SBSB_RETIRE_DT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  RUNID_834, SBSB_ID, GRGR_ID, CSCS_ID, CSPI_ID, SGSG_ID, PDPD_ID,  MEME_MEDCD_NO, MEME_HICN, MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME_FIRST_NAME, MEME_MID_INIT, MEME_SEX, MEME_BIRTH_DT, MEME_MCTR_LANG, MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE_TERM_DT, SBAD_ADDR1, SBAD_ADDR2, SBAD_CITY, SBAD_STATE, SBAD_ZIP, SBSB_MCTR_VIP, SGSG_NAME, SBAD_PHONE, PRPR_NPI,  PRAD_CITY, PRAD_STATE, PRAD_ZIP, PRAD_PHONE, PRAD_FAX,SBSB_RETIRE_DT FROM AGP.MMS_EXTRACT_ELIG ORDER BY SBSB_ID, MEPE_EFF_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ADONETSource
ADONETSource derive(CSCS_ID_STR = toString(CSCS_ID),
		MEPE_TERM_DT_STR = toString(MEPE_TERM_DT),
		SBAD_STATE_STR = toString(SBAD_STATE),
		SBAD_ZIP_STR = toString(SBAD_ZIP),
		MEME_MCTR_LANG_STR = toString(MEME_MCTR_LANG),
		SBAD_ADDR2_STR = toString(SBAD_ADDR2),
		MEME_SEX_STR = toString(MEME_SEX),
		MEME_FIRST_NAME_STR = toString(MEME_FIRST_NAME),
		SBAD_ADDR1_STR = toString(SBAD_ADDR1),
		SBSB_ID_STR = toString(SBSB_ID),
		SBAD_PHONE_STR = toString(SBAD_PHONE),
		SBSB_RETIRE_DT_STR = toString(SBSB_RETIRE_DT),
		PRAD_FAX_STR = toString(PRAD_FAX),
		PRAD_PHONE_STR = toString(PRAD_PHONE),
		MEME_BIRTH_DT_STR = toString(MEME_BIRTH_DT),
		MEME_MID_INIT_STR = toString(MEME_MID_INIT),
		SGSG_NAME_STR = toString(SGSG_NAME),
		MEME_MEDCD_NO_STR = toString(MEME_MEDCD_NO),
		PDPD_ID_STR = toString(PDPD_ID),
		PRAD_CITY_STR = toString(PRAD_CITY),
		MEME_HICN_STR = toString(MEME_HICN),
		PRAD_ZIP_STR = toString(PRAD_ZIP),
		GRGR_ID_STR = toString(GRGR_ID),
		SGSG_ID_STR = toString(SGSG_ID),
		PRAD_STATE_STR = toString(PRAD_STATE),
		MEPE_EFF_DT_STR = toString(MEPE_EFF_DT),
		SBAD_CITY_STR = toString(SBAD_CITY),
		MEME_LAST_NAME_STR = toString(MEME_LAST_NAME),
		CSPI_ID_STR = toString(CSPI_ID),
		SBSB_MCTR_VIP_STR = toString(SBSB_MCTR_VIP),
		PRPR_NPI_STR = toString(PRPR_NPI)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(FileName = $fileName,
		GroupRefId = CSPI_ID_STR + CSCS_ID_STR + '  ' + (iif(isNull(SGSG_ID_STR), '', SGSG_ID_STR))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		ZIP as string,
		DEATHDT as string,
		CTY as string,
		STATE as string,
		HICN as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		ADDR2 as string,
		RACECD as string,
		ADDR1 as string,
		PROV_STATE as string,
		GENDERCD as string,
		FILENAME as string,
		BRTHDT as string,
		PROV_CTY as string,
		COUNTY_REFID as string,
		GROUP_REFID as string,
		LANGCD as string,
		PER_COMM1 as string,
		SUBSCRIBERID as string,
		RESP_COMM2 as string,
		ACCOUNT_CS as string,
		RUNID as long,
		NMLAST as string,
		COMM1 as string,
		NMMIDDLE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		TERMDT as string,
		EFFDT as string,
		NMFIRST as string,
		MEDICAIDID as string,
		PROV_ZIP as string,
		PROV_IDCD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ZIP = SBAD_ZIP_STR,
		DEATHDT = SBSB_RETIRE_DT_STR,
		CTY = SBAD_CITY_STR,
		STATE = SBAD_STATE_STR,
		HICN = MEME_HICN_STR,
		PDPD_ID = PDPD_ID_STR,
		ADDR2 = SBAD_ADDR2_STR,
		RACECD = SBSB_MCTR_VIP_STR,
		ADDR1 = SBAD_ADDR1_STR,
		PROV_STATE = PRAD_STATE_STR,
		GENDERCD = MEME_SEX_STR,
		FILENAME = FileName,
		BRTHDT = MEME_BIRTH_DT_STR,
		PROV_CTY = PRAD_CITY_STR,
		COUNTY_REFID = SGSG_NAME_STR,
		GROUP_REFID = GroupRefId,
		LANGCD = MEME_MCTR_LANG_STR,
		PER_COMM1 = PRAD_PHONE_STR,
		SUBSCRIBERID = SBSB_ID_STR,
		RESP_COMM2 = PRAD_FAX_STR,
		ACCOUNT_CS = CSPI_ID_STR,
		RUNID = RUNID_834,
		NMLAST = MEME_LAST_NAME_STR,
		COMM1 = SBAD_PHONE_STR,
		NMMIDDLE = MEME_MID_INIT_STR,
		GRGR_ID = GRGR_ID_STR,
		TERMDT = MEPE_TERM_DT_STR,
		EFFDT = MEPE_EFF_DT_STR,
		NMFIRST = MEME_FIRST_NAME_STR,
		MEDICAIDID = MEME_MEDCD_NO_STR,
		PROV_ZIP = PRAD_ZIP_STR,
		PROV_IDCD = PRPR_NPI_STR)) ~> OLEDBDestination
